summary: I tested login, the pincode fix, the calculator, the loan calculator, bill upload and the admin panel end to end on the backend and in the UI. Backend: 85 of 85 pytest tests pass. The old tests now log in with test number 9999900001 / OTP 246810, and a new file test_auth_admin.py covers auth, activity, bills, admin APIs and route security. Frontend: all the requested flows work at 1920px. The pincode bug is fixed: 110032 shows Delhi (NCT) / East Delhi / BYPL / Rs 8.1; 202001 then switches everything to Uttar Pradesh / Aligarh / DVVNL / Rs 7.1; 380001 offers UGVCL and Torrent; 999999 clears the old fields and shows weather-error; typing a new pin quickly never leaves old fields. One real UI bug: on mobile (390px) the whole loan calculator page scrolls sideways. I also found some smaller issues, listed below.

minor.issue: The lockout key is request.client.host, which is the ingress/proxy IP. So 5 wrong passwords from anyone lock the admin out for everyone for 15 min. The OTP send limit uses x-forwarded-for, so the two are inconsistent.
Any logged-in user can read every customer's leads and projects. These are not limited to the owner or an admin.

allow_origins='*' together with allow_credentials=True. The server echoes back any Origin (checked with https://evil.com). Impact is low because tokens are Bearer headers in localStorage, not cookies, but explicit origins are better.
The file type check trusts the content-type the client sends; the file bytes are never checked.
Each login overwrites the stored user name with whatever was typed. Logout only clears the token in the browser; the 30-day JWT stays valid on the server.

ui_bugs.issue: The whole page scrolls sideways (document scrollWidth 686px at a 390px viewport). The comparison table's min-w-[620px] stretches the single grid column instead of scrolling inside its card. As a result the input card is cut off on the right ('GST on i…'), the disclaimer is cut and the Save button sits at the far left edge. Fix: add min-w-0 to the right column (<div className="space-y-4 min-w-0">, line 105) or use grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)] on mobile.

While the pincode has fewer than 6 digits (for example 202001 edited to 11003), the auto-detected cards still show the previous pin's state, city and DISCOM. Clicking calculate then uses the old location and saves the activity with the partial pincode. Clear the auto-filled fields when the pin no longer matches autoPin.
Changing the state by hand (Delhi to Haryana) correctly clears the DISCOM and the auto-filled tariff, but the city stays 'East Delhi'.

issues: scrollIntoView puts the 'Solar Opportunity Report' title under the sticky header. Add scroll-margin-top.
Sonner toasts at top-center cover the header nav for several seconds.
'Solar for Business' and 'Project Models' wrap onto two lines.

Lease 'Total you pay' and 'Effective annual cost' include GST on rentals (19.64% vs 12.15% reducing). For GST-registered businesses that can claim it back, this makes the lease look much worse. Consider an input-tax-credit toggle.

action_items: Fix the sideways scroll on the mobile loan calculator: add min-w-0 to the right column in LoanCalculator.jsx.
Update /app/memory/test_credentials.md. It still says there is no auth. Add the admin email/password and the OTP test numbers 9999900001/9999900002 with code 246810.
On the calculator, clear the auto-filled state, city and DISCOM as soon as the pincode differs from autoPin; clear the city on a manual state change too.
Base the admin login lockout on x-forwarded-for, not the proxy IP.
Limit GET /api/leads/{id} and the EPC project and partner lists to the owner or an admin.
critical_code_review_comments: Calculator.jsx is 1130 lines, over the 700-line limit. Split out SolarDataCard, AdvSection, the results report and the lead form.
server.py submit_project still uses db.leads directly instead of require_db() (left over from earlier).
Admin openBill: window.open(blobUrl, '_blank', 'noopener') opens a popup (seen in the test), but the blob URL is never revoked.

Playbook auth checks: (1) the admin hash starts with $2b$ (OK). (2) Login does not set httpOnly cookies; JWTs are kept in localStorage (a design choice, but exposed to XSS). (3) CORS echoes any origin with credentials (not OK). (4) Brute-force lockout: OTP verify gives 429 after 5 wrong codes (verified); admin login has a 5-attempt / 15-min lock in code, but I only ran one wrong password. (5) The admin is created lazily on first login only if missing and its password is never overwritten (OK, from code review).

context_for_next_testing_agent: conftest.py logs in by calling /api/auth/otp/verify directly. Test numbers need no send step, so this avoids the limit of 5 sends per phone per hour. test_wrong_code_and_lockout locks 9999900002 for 15 min; afterwards, delete its otp_failures. To skip the login UI in Playwright, get a token with curl /api/auth/otp/verify and set localStorage 'si_token'. Pincode lookups take 2-10 s; wait until [data-testid=pincode-loading] disappears.
